theme: Filling a table with only structural hints
title: Ledger Recovery Under Blackout Blocks
strategies: row-mean baseline: fill every missing cell with the mean of the observed entries in its own row (falls back to the global mean for a row with no observations)

pattern-blind low-rank completion: warm-start missing cells with the row mean, then repeatedly refit a fixed-rank SVD of the current filled matrix and overwrite the missing cells with its reconstruction (never touches the side-information graphs)

graph-identified two-way ANOVA: recover row-group and column-group identity from the connected components of the two similarity graphs, then block-coordinate-descend a block-effect + row-bias + column-bias additive fit on the observed entries and evaluate it everywhere, including inside a fully-blacked-out block
